annotations.title: Submit a campaign and start calling

description:
COSTS MONEY: Submit a campaign and start calling

Hands a draft campaign to the calling infrastructure and starts it. This is the point where calls are actually placed and charged, so treat it as the irreversible step: only a campaign in state `draft` can be submitted, and submitting one in any other state is refused with 409. A campaign whose recipient list turned out to be empty is refused with 400. If the campaign carries a scheduled time it moves to `scheduled` and dialling begins then, otherwise it moves to `pending` and begins immediately; the state may come straight back as `running` or `completed` if dispatch reports that far already. Outbound calling being unconfigured on the platform gives 503, and a dispatch that returned no batch identifier gives 502. This operation uses the `write:agents` scope rather than a scope of its own.

campaignId.description: Identifier of the draft campaign to submit.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.
